about: Pantry run modelled as a generic product: drawer-over-cupboard unit, sink unit with pair of doors, open bay with under-counter fridge (door, grip, kick grille), HPL worktop and upstand, stainless sink with waste and drainer with grooves, lever mixer with swan neck, wall-mounted water boiler with panel, LEDs, tap and drip tray, 2-leaf wall cupboard sized to the run. Services enter through a shared box behind the plinth. Each type has its own geometry (parts carry 'only' for their type); shared parts have none.
